description.value: The Sardis Library is a single-storey public branch of the Fraser Valley Regional Library serving the Sardis neighbourhood of Chilliwack. As a fully accessible, free-admission public facility, it welcomes all visitors with outdoor bike racks, free Wi-Fi, public computers, and quiet study zones. Touring cyclists will find it a practical rest stop with accessible restrooms, baby changing stations, and a range of community services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Sardis Library website explicitly lists 'Outdoor Bike Racks' (bike_dock icon), 'WiFi', and 'Accessible Restrooms' as branch features, confirming bike parking, Wi-Fi, and washrooms. 'Low Water Fountains' (water_drop icon) are listed under accessibility features, indicating potable water on site; as a free public library (OSM access=yes), this water is available without admission. OSM contact details (phone, address, website URL) all corroborate the website content.
